videoTitle: Why Your Honeymoon Might Feel Wrong (Even After 12 Years Together)
videoDescription: Feeling disconnected or regretful right after your wedding doesn't mean you married the wrong person. Research shows post-wedding emotional letdowns are common—and often about unmet expectations and family dynamics, not your relationship. Learn what's really happening at mindtivate.com
script: You've been together twelve years and suddenly your honeymoon feels wrong. That ick you're feeling? It's probably not about your partner at all—it's about what marriage just made permanent...
Visit mindtivate.com to find the answer.
thumbnailConcept: A close-up, intimate shot of a woman sitting on the edge of a sunlit luxury resort bed on her honeymoon, staring blankly ahead with a subtle look of quiet panic and heavy contemplation, while her husband sleeps peacefully in the background. The contrast between the beautiful, romantic tropical setting outside the window and her tense, isolated posture captures the sudden, confusing dread of permanence.
